query:
INSERT INTO organization_seller_profiles (
            organization_id,
            content,
            created_by_user_id,
            updated_by_user_id
         )
         VALUES ($1, $2::jsonb, $3, $3)
         ON CONFLICT (organization_id) DO UPDATE
             SET content = organization_seller_profiles.content || EXCLUDED.content,
                 updated_by_user_id = EXCLUDED.updated_by_user_id
         RETURNING id AS "id!: Uuid"
